data.name: Spirited Charge (Mythic)
data.description: Your mounted charge knocks the wind and wits from those foolish enough to stand against you.

raw_tokens.value: Your mounted charge knocks the wind and wits from those foolish enough to stand against you.

When you hit an opponent with a mounted charge, that opponent must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw (DC %1) or be staggered for %2 rounds. If you use a lance with this attack, increase the saving throw DC by 2. As a free action before you make the attack, you can expend one use of mythic power to daze your opponent on a failed saving throw instead of staggering it.|Feat_SpiritedCharge_MythicDC|MythicLevel
